purpose: Prepare exact post-N220 filtered execution rank/unrank while preserving the N104/N106 old canonical stratum-local rank as the completeness authority.

source_locks.n104_state_contract: every old canonical terminal rank in every manifest stratum receives exactly one disposition
source_locks.n106_state_contract: work identity remains stratum-local (row_id,d,e) plus the existing local CompressedTerminalIndexer(e,d) rank domain

secondary_survivor_rank.definition: F(r)=number of N220-accepted old canonical ranks q with 0<=q<r
secondary_survivor_rank.unrank_definition: U(k)=the unique accepted old rank r with F(r)=k
secondary_survivor_rank.x4_block_preservation: Because N220 is independent of x4 and x4 is innermost, filtered_rank=accepted_exceptional_rank*(normal_budget+1)+x4; only the exceptional-rank axis needs compression.
required_identities: U(F(r))=r for every accepted old rank r

symbolic_target.method: accepted-subtree prefix-count DP under the exact source-locked UNEQUAL-then-EQUAL exceptional order; x4 block remains untouched
symbolic_target.reason: N220 depends on exceptional prefix coordinates and (g,d,e), not on the independent normal coordinate x4

remaining_implementation_gate: N220 hostile-audit PASS before authoritative pruning or production integration; after PASS, implement accepted-exceptional-subtree rank/unrank preserving the locked old order.
